newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.

text.p: * Parliament's upper Senate house ratified the friendship treaty between Romania and Hungary. Ruling party senators said the treaty was important to boost the chances of Romania's integration into NATO.
* Lower Chamber of Deputies ended debates on draft law on privatisation of state banks.
* President Ion Iliescu's spokesman Traian Chebeleu said he hoped that the treaty with Hungary would soon be ratified by both houses of parliament.
* Chebeleu told a news conference that Iliescu would also run a seat on the Senate on the lists of the ruling Party of Social Democracy in the November 3 polls.
* Nicu Ceausescu, 45, youngest son of Romania's late dictator Nicolae Ceausescu, died in a Vienna hospital on Thursday morning of severe liver disease.
* The defence ministry has urged mayoralties to mail electoral cards to army barracks so that conscripts may cast their ballots in the November 3 polls.
* Japan has granted $500,000 to repair Romanian monuments. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
